exposure: presence of bilateral ulnar longitudinal deficiency with oligodactyly
outcome: upper limb malformations (shortening of left forearm, absence of three digits bilaterally)
diagnosis of congenital longitudinal deficiency of the ulna
cohort: A full-term male newborn, born following an uncomplicated gestation, presented with upper limb malformations.
finding: A full-term male newborn was diagnosed with bilateral ulnar longitudinal deficiency with oligodactyly based on neonatal physical examination and diagnostic investigations.
